name: Jishji
title: Descendants of Benjamin
summary: Jishji (also known as Jishji) was a person mentioned in the biblical genealogies. He is listed as a descendant of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles. He belonged to one of the prominent families of the tribe of Benjamin who settled in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jisji is listed as one of the sons of Elpaal in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, who lived in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribe of Benjamin in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Jisji belonged to the family heads of the tribe of Benjamin who were settled in Jerusalem and recorded in the genealogical registers.

keyEvents.title: The Family Heads of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Jisji was among the family heads registered by their clans as part of Israel's tribal organization.

keyEvents.title: Benjamin's Descendants in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The author of Chronicles included Jisji in the detailed genealogy to show continuity in God's people and the organization of the tribes after the return from exile.
